entities.name: Francis Hong Yong-ho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Hong Yong-ho was a Catholic prelate in North Korea who was imprisoned by the communist regime of Kim Il Sung in 1949 and later disappeared. After his disappearance, he was for many years listed as the Bishop of Pyongyang.
